t: Betza shennoleda berosh hashshana veseder haqqiddush
s: Betza shennoleda berosh hashshana veseder haqqiddush ubo z' seipim: ap bene eretz yisrael osin shene yamim rosh hashshana, lepi shemmah shehen en osin shear moadot ella yom echad hattaam mishshum sheanu beqiin becheshbon qebiut hechodashim, veanu yodeim yom sherauy liqboa hachodesh velimnot mimmennu hammoadot, veap bene gola en osin shene yamim ella mishshum shehem tzerikin leqayyem minhag abotehem shehayu osim shene yamim bizman shehayu meqaddeshin al pi hareiyya, sheen haddabar taluy becheshbon kelal ella biriyyat hallebana, velo hayu bene gola yodein yom shehuqba bo hachodesh birushalayim vehayu osin shene yamim missapeq, abal bene eretz yisrael haqqerobim lirushalayim lo hayu osin hammoadot ella yom echad, lepi shehabbet din shebbirushalayim hayu sholechim sheluchim lehodia lahem yom shenniqba bo hachodesh benisan (ubesivan) ubetishre, ubekol hammeqomot haqqerobim shehayu hashsheluchim maggiin alehem qodem yom tob lo hayu osin ella yom echad, ulepikak ap benehem acharehem akshav enan tzerikin laasot shene yamim, kevan sheanu beqiim bacheshbon veyodeim yom sherauy liqboa bo hachodesh velimnot mimmennu hachodesh. Vezeh hattaam lo shayyak ella bishar moadot chutz merosh hashshana, abal berosh hashshana ap bene eretz yisrael tzerikim leqayyem minhag abotehem shehayu osin shene yamim bizman shehayu meqaddeshin al pi hareiyya, shello haya haddabar taluy bidiat hacheshbon ella biqbiut habbet din shebbirushalayim al pi reiyyat (haedim et) hallebana, veap al pi shehabbet din hayu meshallechin sheluchim lehodia lakkol, mikkol maqom berosh hashshana shehu yom tob en hashsheluchim yekolim latzet chutz lattechum:

Veap baggola rosh hashshana hu chaluq mishshear moadot, sheshshear moadot ap abotehem lo hayu osin shene yamim ella mechamat hassapeq shello hayu yodeim yom shehuqba bo hachodesh beeretz yisrael, ubetza shennoleda beyom rishon mutteret beyom sheni, sheim hayyom qodesh lemachar hu chol veen bo issur muqtzeh venolad, veim lemachar qodesh hayyom chol ukebar hukena habbetza meereb yom tob, ulepikak ap benehem acharehem hayyodeim biqbiut hachodesh veyodeim sheyyom rishon hu iqqar yom tob veyom sheni hu gam ken yom tob middibre soperim, ap al pi ken en din betza zo kedin betza shennoleda bishne yamim tobim hassemukim zeh lazeh kegon shabbat veyom tob sheim noleda bazeh asura bazeh kemo shennitbaer besiman tqy"g, dekevan shehen en osin shene yamim ella mechamat minhag abotehem — en tzarik lehachamir yoter meabotehem shehaya muttar lahem mittaam shennitbaer:

Abal bishne yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana eno ken, ella hen nechshabim keyom echad arok uqedushsha achat hen ap libne eretz yisrael, ubetza shennoleda barishon, o dabar shennitlash min hamchubbar barishon, o dabar shennitztzad barishon, keshem sheasur bo bayyom mishshum muqtzeh venolad — kak asur beyom sheni shehem keyom echad arok, chutz milleinyan met beyom sheni kemo shennitbaer besiman tqk"v:

Velama hen nechshabin keyom echad? Vahare anu beqiin biqbiut hachodesh veanu yodein sherishon iqqar, mishshum deap habbet din atzman shehayu meqaddeshin al pi hareiyya hayu osin lipamim shene yamim, ketzad? Barishona keshehiggia yom l' beelul hayu kol yisrael vehabbet din nohagin issur melaka uqedushshat hayyom mibbaereb, deshemma yabou edim lemachar veyomru sherau hallebana belayla zo veyihyeh hayyom rosh chodesh tishre vehu rosh hashshana venimtza shehallayla hu yom tob, ubayyom hayu habbet din yoshebin umetzappim lebiat edim roe hallebana ulay yabou vekol shaa sheyyabou bayyom ad shettechshak hayu meqaddeshin et hachodesh oto hayyom vehaya rosh hashshana bo bayyom, umeoto yom vahalea monin leyom hakkippurim ulesukkot, vehayu tamid regilin labo qodem zeman mincha, dehaynu zeman haqrabat tamid shel ben haarbayim, paam achat nishtahu haedim millabo ad achar hammincha vehiqribu hattamid venitqalqelu halviyyim bashshir veameru shir shel chol, shehayu seburim shello yabou haedim od hayyom, ukeshebbau — nimtza hayyom lemaprea qodesh, umeoto hayyom vahalea hitqinu chakamim shello yihyu habbet din meqabbelin et haedim ella ad hammincha, ukesheyyabou leachar hammincha — yihyeh oto hayyom min chodesh heabar limnot oto yom l' shel elul velimnot leyom hakkippurim ulesukkot miyyom hammochorat, sheyyesh koach beyad bet din laasot dabar zeh, shenneemar "elleh moade Hashem asher tiqreu otam", "atam" ketib belo va"v — "attem" apillu mezidin. Umikkol maqom, ap al pi sheen monin lammoadot miyyom zeh ukechol hu chashub veyom tob yihyeh lemachar, ap al pi ken lo hayu mezalzelim bo vehayu gomerim oto beissuro biqdushshat yom tob ad hallayla middibre soperim, kevan shemmin haddin haya hu rauy lihyot yom tob min hattora ella shennittan reshut lebet din lidchot, ulemachar osin yom tob verosh hashshana shel tora, veellu shene hayyamim hen qedushsha achat ukeyom echad arok, ushenehem niqraim yom tob shel rosh hashshana, yom rishon middibre soperim veyom sheni middibre tora. Vehammeqomot shehen chutz lattechum shel yerushalayim hayu tzerikin laasot shene yamim rosh hashshana bekol shana veshana, deshemma yabou edim achar hammincha venimtza sheshshene hayyamim hen qodesh ukeyom echad hen chashubim, shehare qedushsha achat alehem, dehaynu qedushshat rosh hashshana, veachar yom tob keshehayu hashsheluchim yotzein vehayu modiim lekol bene eretz yisrael yom shehuqba bo hachodesh, vehayu hakkol monin mimmennu leyom hakkippurim ulesukkot. Vekak haya haddabar noheg tamid ad shebbatelu sanhedrin ubatal qiddush hachodesh al pi hareiyya vehitchilu liqboa hechodashim al pi hacheshbon, ulepikak hakkol monin miyyom rishon shel rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim ulesukkot, lepi sheal pi hacheshbon elul leolam chaser, veap al pi ken tzerikin hen leqayyem minhag abotehem shehayu bizman qiddush hachodesh al pi hareiyya, vehayu osin shene yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana ap beeretz yisrael, vehayu osin oto keyom echad arok, uqedushsha achat alehen, ubetza shennoleda bazeh asura bazeh mittaam shennitbaer shemma bau edim achar hammincha, lepikak ap sheen taam zeh shayyak lazzeman sheqqobein chodashim al pi hacheshbon uleolam yom rishon hu iqqar vehu yom tob shel tora, mikkol maqom en lezalzel beyom sheni ulehaqel bo mah shello hayu meqillin bo abotenu:

Ap al pi shebbekol yom tob sheni shel galuyyot omerim zeman baqqiddush, kevan sheosin oto mechamat hassapeq shehaya laabotenu (bizman shehayu meqaddeshin al pi hareiyya) shemma hayyom qodesh veetmol chol im ken lo niptar bazzeman shel etmol, abal belel sheni shel rosh hashshana yesh omerim sheen omerim zeman, kevan sheshshene hayyamim hen qedushsha achat ukeyom echad hen chashubin, im ken niptar bazzeman shel etmol shehu techillat qedushshat hayyom, velamma yachazor lomar zeman baemtza, veken beyom sheni al hashshopar en lomar zeman, shekkebar niptar bazzeman sheamar etmol al hashshopar. Abal yesh omerim shetztzarik lomar zeman ben beqiddush lel sheni ben al hashshopar, mishshum shemmah shehen nechshabin keyom echad arok eno ella mechamat minhag abotenu shehayu bizman qiddush hachodesh al pi hareiyya vehayu chosheshin shemma bau edim achar hammincha venimtza sheshshene hayyamim hen yom tob echad uqedushsha achat alehem, vekevan sheabotenu hayu mebarekin zeman beyom sheni ap shehayu osin otan qedushsha achat ukeyom echad, shehare im bau edim achar hammincha iqqar hayyom tob shel tora hu lemachar veyom rishon eno ella middibre soperim ukechol hu chashub legabbe yom sheni shebbo huqba hachodesh, lepikak gam lanu yesh lebarek zeman belel sheni (ap beeretz yisrael) kemo shemmebarekin bekol yom tob sheni shel galuyyot kede shello leshannot mimminhag abotenu:

Vahalaka kassebara haacharona. Mikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob sheyyotzi adam et atzmo mide sepeq beraka, veyilbosh malbush chadash beinyan shetztzarik lebarek alayv shehecheyanu bishat hallebisha kemo shennitbaer besiman rk"g, o yiqqach peri chadash veyannichennu lepanayv beet haqqiddush, vibarek "shehecheyanu" vihe dato gam al hammalbush o al happeri. Veim yesh lo tirosh chadash — lo yeqaddesh alayv kede lebarek alayv "shehecheyanu", demitzva min hammubchar leqaddesh al yayin yashan kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"b, ella yeqaddesh al hayyashan veyanniach hattirosh lepanayv, ukesheyyaggia le"shehecheyanu" yiqqach hakkos shel tirosh beyado o yitten enayv bo vibarek "shehecheyanu", veyishteh hakkos shel yayin yashan. Veim en lo beged chadash uperi chadash — im kol zeh yebarek "shehecheyanu", shehaiqqar kassebara haacharona:

Veken bitqiat shopar shel yom sheni, lekattechilla yilbash hattoqea beged chadash veyihyeh alayv bishat birkat "shehecheyanu" (uminhag separad shello lebarek "shehecheyanu"). Veim chal yom rishon beshabbat shello taqeu bashshopar — eno tzarik lilbosh beged chadash bishat teqiot yom sheni, kevan shello berak adayin "shehecheyanu" al hashshopar:
